facts.note: At the temple's nine, the husband had everyone show watches; Félix's read twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolded him for it.
At the temple's ten she looked at the salon clock, which showed five minutes to ten.
Piquet in the salon without a break until the doctor went out for cigars, at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
As he left he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after his return, the hall clock struck eleven.

added.quote: I know the time because I had just looked at it.
added.why: She was looking at the salon clock immediately before he left, so the 10:28 departure is a reading she checked at that moment, not just a figure reported afterwards; this places her attention on the clock just before 10:28.
